There is no clock. The game goes on until a meter hits zero, or you finish the run.
Each morning, set boundaries: Focus mode, Phone-free dinner, Bedtime and Mute group chats. They cost a little to set up and every day, but the phone calls Bea much less.
Four meters: Sleep, Mood, Study and Social. Keep all of them above half for a good day.
Each day has six parts. In each one something happens, and you pick what Bea does. The effects show after you choose.
Points come from keeping the meters balanced. A good day is worth a bonus.

Keep Bea balanced through day after day, as long as you can. The phone pulls harder as the days go by. Set boundaries each morning, choose well, and see how many days you get. If any meter runs out, Bea needs a reset day.

Help Bea through three days. Each day has six parts, and in each one her phone, or real life, asks her for something. Choose what she does and keep her Sleep, Mood, Study and Social meters balanced. If a meter runs out, Bea has a reset day, and that is a lesson, not a fail: you always finish.
Pick the boundaries for today. Each costs a little now and every day, and makes the phone call Bea much less in the part of the day it covers. You can switch them on or off each morning.
